help.stdout:
usage: gnd recovery inventory [-h] [--source PATH] [--tests PATH]
                              [--docs PATH] [--config PATH] [--schema PATH]
                              [--exclude REASON=PATH]
                              [--max-file-bytes MAX_FILE_BYTES]
                              [--max-total-bytes MAX_TOTAL_BYTES]
                              [--max-files MAX_FILES] --out INVENTORY.json
                              ROOT

Read explicitly selected source, test, documentation, configuration, and
schema roots as inert bytes. Every selected path is classified as parsed,
excluded, ambiguous, or frontier; source text is never copied into the
inventory. --exclude uses REASON=PATH where REASON is dependency, vendored,
generated, cache, build, or sensitive-tree. The output is write-once. Exits 3
for an empty/malformed scope, 66 for a missing root, and 74 for an
unsafe/unreadable path or refused output.

positional arguments:
  ROOT                  authoritative existing repository root

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source PATH         repository-relative source root (repeatable)
  --tests PATH          repository-relative test root (repeatable)
  --docs PATH           repository-relative documentation root (repeatable)
  --config PATH         repository-relative configuration root (repeatable)
  --schema PATH         repository-relative schema root (repeatable)
  --exclude REASON=PATH
                        closed exclusion reason and repository-relative path
                        (repeatable)
  --max-file-bytes MAX_FILE_BYTES
                        maximum bytes read from one selected file (default:
                        2097152)
  --max-total-bytes MAX_TOTAL_BYTES
                        maximum aggregate bytes read from selected files
                        (default: 33554432)
  --max-files MAX_FILES
                        maximum selected file observations (default: 10000)
  --out INVENTORY.json  write-once inventory JSON destination beneath ROOT
